name: Ministry of Revenues EIRS Production Gateway
purpose: Official statutory electronic invoice registration, IRN/RRN authorization, and cryptographic signature return
owner: FDRE Ministry of Revenues (MoR) / EIRS Directorate
requiredCredentials: Production Mutual TLS (mTLS) Client Certificate & Private Key
requiredNetworkAccess: TCP Port 443 outbound with TLS 1.3 / mTLS client auth
failClosedBehavior: In production mode, invoices buffer locally in encrypted store with 72-hour SLA when EIRS is unavailable.

name: INSA Hardware Security Module (HSM) / PKCS#11 Cryptographic Token
purpose: Non-exportable private key custody, SHA-256 with RSA-2048 digital signing mandated by Directive Art. 4(6)
owner: Information Network Security Administration (INSA) / Certified Hardware Vendor (Thales/Utimaco)
productionConnectionStatus: PRODUCTION_DISCONNECTED (Pending Physical Appliance / Cloud HSM Endpoint)
requiredNetworkAccess: PCIe local bus interface or dedicated private HSM VPC subnet (TCP 2223 / 2225)
failClosedBehavior: In production HSM mode, software fallback is strictly prohibited. Signing requests throw IllegalStateException.

name: Ethio Telecom Commercial SMS Gateway
purpose: Automated delivery of certified invoice particulars to buyer mobile devices mandated by Art. 4(1)(i)
requiredCredentials: REGISTERED_SHORT_CODE (Sender Name / Short Code approved by Ethio Telecom)
requiredNetworkAccess: TCP Port 443 / SMPP Port 2775 outbound to Ethio Telecom gateways
failClosedBehavior: In production mode, unconfigured SMS triggers non-blocking alert in outbox worker without blocking fiscal invoice generation.

name: Production SMTP Transport Service
purpose: Buyer tax invoice delivery via email and administrative alerting
owner: Enterprise Infrastructure Team / Cloud Email Provider
failClosedBehavior: Fails closed in prod if unconfigured; development operates in simulation mode.

name: Dual-Datacenter Secondary Tier III Facility
purpose: Dual datacenter active/standby replication mandated by Directive Art. 5(4) & Art. 14(3)(a)
owner: Certified Ethiopian Datacenter Operator (e.g. Raxio / Ethio Telecom DC)
softwareImplementationStatus: SOFTWARE_COMPLETE (PostgreSQL streaming replication & Patroni cluster scripts)
requiredNetworkAccess: Dedicated redundant 10Gbps low-latency interconnect between DC1 and DC2
failClosedBehavior: Single DC operation triggers high-priority operational alert in platform readiness probes.

name: Commercial Bank Performance Guarantee Bond
purpose: Statutory financial security bond ($50,000 to $250,000 USD) mandated by Directive Art. 14(3)(f) & Art. 14(6)
requiredCredentials: Irrevocable Bank Guarantee Bond Document referencing Directive No. 1142/2026
failClosedBehavior: Administrative license gate blocks commercial rollout until MoR accepts bond.

name: Public Domain DNS & EV TLS Certificates
purpose: Secure HTTPS ingress, public invoice verification QR endpoints, and M2M API endpoints
softwareImplementationStatus: SOFTWARE_COMPLETE (TLS 1.3 reverse proxy & Spring security configs)
requiredCredentials: X.509 Wildcard / SAN SSL/TLS Certificates from publicly trusted CA (DigiCert / Let's Encrypt)
requiredNetworkAccess: Public Static IPv4/IPv6 registered with MoR under Directive Art. 14(3)(d)
failClosedBehavior: Plaintext HTTP is permanently disabled; HSTS enforced.
